title: "Confirmed Kill" Delivers Action, Suspense, and Twists at Every Turn
text:
“Confirmed Kill” Delivers Action, Suspense, and Twists at Every Turn By: AB Newswire March 05, 2025 at 17:02 PM EST by K. B. Jones Confirmed Kill by K. B. Jones is a pulse-pounding thriller that is about the world of professional assassins, high-stakes deception, and deadly consequences. This gripping novel takes a reader on a gripping adventure through an underworld where every move could be the last. In this underworld, crime lords have complete control, running illegal businesses in secret. Gangs rule the streets, selling drugs, weapons, and even people, using fear and violence to stay in power. Silent assassins remove threats without leaving a trace. Corrupt officials protect the rich and powerful and make justice impossible.
Those in charge pull the strings from behind the scenes, never getting their hands dirty. Betrayal is everywhere, and even close friends can turn into deadly enemies. In this world, survival isn’t just about being strong; it’s about being smart, staying hidden, and knowing when to make a move.
This story is about a skilled contract killer who is great at watching his targets and never missing a shot. He knows how to stay hidden and plans every job carefully. However, this time, his mission is different. As he learns more about his target, he finds himself caught in a dangerous game full of secrets and lies.
At the same time, Detective Mitsi Silverman, who is charming, smart and determined, is working to find the truth behind the killer’s actions. "He could follow someone for days without being seen, and when it was time, his shot was always perfect." As the chase goes on, both the killer and the detective move closer to a shocking truth. Neither of them expected it was there.
This book has razor-sharp prose and over-the-top pacing. Confirmed Kill is a must-read if you are a fan of crime thrillers, espionage, and psychological suspense. K. B. Jones writes a story filled with unpredictable twists, deep character exploration, and an atmosphere thick with tension. As dark as it may seem, but has many elements to it. Readers who enjoy the works of Lee Child, Vince Flynn, or David Baldacci will find themselves completely lost in this electrifying tale.
K. B. Jones is a storyteller with a talent for creating high-stakes thrillers that engage and surprise.Jones brings authenticity and depth to his stories, creating characters that are as compelling as they are dangerous. Confirmed Kill is the latest example of his ability to create intense action with psychological flavor, keeping a reader interested from start to finish.
Availability Confirmed Kill is available now.
Get ready for a thriller that doesn’t let go-pick up Confirmed Kill today!
